subject: Vendor initiation: insurance intake + PO mapping for Tilthrive
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@tilthrive.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor initiation: insurance intake + PO mapping for Tilthrive

Hi Elena —

Thanks for starting the onboarding process. Procurement has begun intake for Tilthrive so we can get a PO live and schedule billing. To move this to procurement queue, we need the following evidence: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing commercial general liability with $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate and a cyber liability policy (limits + retroactive date).
- Named insured and subcontractor list (if any) — we need to confirm whether subvendors are covered under Tilthrive's policy.
- Claims history (loss runs) for the past 36 months (summary PDF is fine).
- Completed Vendor Risk Intake spreadsheet (attached template). Please populate rows marked "procurement only."
- Preferred invoice remittance and your supplier payment terms (Net 30, ACH details, or PO-only billing).

A couple of specific asks that help us map to Redwood systems: 
- Can you confirm Tilthrive's internal vendor code (if you have one) or provide a simple mapping to these categories: Software SaaS, Professional Services, Hardware/Edge, Other.
- If you require a particular PO/reference on invoices, note that now so we can align accounting fields.

Attachments: I attached the Vendor_Risk_Form.xlsx we use for intake and a short PO mapping guide.

If you can get the COI + completed spreadsheet back by end of day Friday (Nov 13), we should be able to issue a conditional PO by next week. If anything on our requirements is a blocker, tell me which item and we'll route an exception.

Thanks —

Chloe Martin
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment stubs: Vendor_Risk_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet), PO_Mapping_Guide.pdf (doc)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@tilthrive.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor initiation: insurance intake + PO mapping for Tilthrive

Hi Chloe —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers here and next steps from our side: 

- We can provide a COI that names Redwood Inference as an additional insured and includes the required limits.
- Subcontractor list: Tilthrive uses two subcontractors for on-site installs (Nimble Install Co., CloudLift Subservices). I am attaching a short subcontractor disclosure.
- Claims history: we have a summarized loss-run PDF, will attach.
- Vendor code: internal reference is TILT-0421; primary category is Hardware/Edge.
- Payment terms: standard Net30 ACH; we can invoice with your PO number once provided.

We should have the COI and the filled Vendor_Risk_Form back to you by Thursday EOD PST. If you need the COI earlier for underwriting, we can expedite.

Best,

Elena Ruiz
Head of Supply Operations
Tilthrive Labs
elena.ruiz@tilthrive.io
+1 212-555-0199

Attachment stubs: Subcontractor_Disclosure.pdf, Tilthrive_LossRuns_2023-25.pdf

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@tilthrive.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor initiation: insurance intake + PO mapping for Tilthrive

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Two follow-ups from procurement and legal to keep this moving: 

1) Legal asked to confirm whether Tilthrive's cyber policy includes coverage for subcontractor breaches (many cyber policies carve out subcontracts). If the cyber policy excludes that, Legal will push for an endorsement or require a contractual flow-down.

2) For the COI: when you request it from your broker, please include the additional insured endorsement language "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents" on the endorsement page; and list Redwood's address: 1201 Market Street, San Francisco, CA 94103.

3) On PO mapping: Procurement wants the vendor category set as "Hardware/Edge — Install Services" and to capture the vendor internal code (TILT-0421) in the Redwood supplier portal. I'll create the supplier record once I receive the completed spreadsheet.

If you have the COI and the completed Vendor_Risk_Form by Thursday, I'll move this into the PO queue and mark it conditional until any endorsement requests are resolved.

Thanks —

Chloe

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@tilthrive.io>

Cc: supplyops@tilthrive.io
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor initiation: insurance intake + PO mapping for Tilthrive

Chloe / Markus / Marissa —

Attaching the COI and completed Vendor Risk Form as requested. Notes below: 

- COI: see Tilthrive_COI.pdf — includes commercial GL and cyber limits, names Redwood Inference as "additional insured" on the endorsement page, and lists the address requested. Broker confirmed retroactive date for cyber is 2024-06-01.
- Vendor_Risk_Form.xlsx: completed rows in the procurement tab; subcontractor list included in the comments column.
- Loss runs: Tilthrive_LossRuns_2023-25.pdf attached (no material claims in the last 36 months).

One item for clarity: our cyber insurer requires that contractual flow-downs be written into the SOW between Redwood and Tilthrive for install services; they advised an endorsement is possible but will take 2–3 weeks. If Redwood needs immediate flow-down protection, Tilthrive can accept a conditional PO with an explicit risk acknowledgement and a target to deliver the endorsement within 21 days of the first invoice.

Happy to hop on a short call if that approach needs legal signoff.

Best,

Elena

Attachment stubs: Tilthrive_COI.pdf, Vendor_Risk_Form.xlsx, Tilthrive_LossRuns_2023-25.pdf
